ACT VIII OF 2013
ACT VIII OF 2013
MARITIME SECURITY AGENCY
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act further to amend the Maritime
Security Agency Act, 1994
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
14th March, 2013]
No. F.9(17)/2012-Legis,
dated 14-3-2013.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on 11th March, 2013, is
hereby published for general information:-
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Maritime Security Agency Act, 1994 (X of 1994), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Maritime Security
Agency (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of long title, Act X of 1994
